body: An open-source vector database that stores objects and embeddings and combines vector search with filters.
plain_description: **Find and organize information by meaning to power smarter search and AI applications.** Combine vector search with keyword filters, recommendations, and RAG. Deploy locally or in the cloud and scale as your needs grow.
technical_description: Weaviate is a cloud-native vector database that stores objects and vectors. It supports semantic and hybrid search, filtering, RAG, reranking, and image search through REST, gRPC, and GraphQL APIs. Vectors can be generated with integrated model providers or supplied as precomputed embeddings. Deployment options include Docker, Kubernetes, Weaviate Cloud, AWS, and GCP.
title: Weaviate
